packages.label: Agency Abundance system
packages.role: Production database schema, API routes, OpenAPI contract, and matching workflow logic.

packages.label: Abundance presentation surface
packages.role: Client-visible explanation/presentation surface for the Abundance operating model.

mcpSurfaces.label: Abundance OpenAPI contract
mcpSurfaces.role: Callable API contract that can be wrapped by the CREATE SOMETHING MCP hub or a dedicated Abundance MCP server.

mcpSurfaces.label: CREATE SOMETHING MCP hub
mcpSurfaces.role: Brokered MCP registry and routing layer used to expose governed tools without making a frontend surface or delivery page the source of truth.

mcpSurfaces.label: Abundance Staff MCP
mcpSurfaces.role: Remote MCP endpoint for staff/operator-facing Abundance workflows. Production smoke passed for active headcount summary; token material is stored outside public artifacts.

mcpSurfaces.label: Abundance Jobs MCP
mcpSurfaces.role: Remote MCP endpoint for nursing-job capture and job-source workflow access. Production smoke passed for public job listing through the shared Abundance MCP bearer.

mcpSurfaces.label: NPG Abundance scoped hub
mcpSurfaces.role: Brokered NPG review hub for Jotform, Mailchimp, and WhatsApp status during final delivery. Production smoke passed for reachability and status calls, but all three services currently report connected=false; NPG account-owner authorization is required before write automation.

agents.label: Delivery Update Agent
agents.role: Stages delivery updates, progress reports, screenshots/images, and client-ready summaries from monorepo evidence.

agents.label: Abundance matching agent boundary
agents.role: Recommendation support for intake, shortlist, missing-information flags, and recruiter review. It does not make autonomous staffing decisions.

agents.label: Abundance Hub Dify agent
agents.role: Dify-side job discovery agent connected to the Abundance Jobs MCP. It is now exposed on the Abundance delivery page through a server-side read-only chat panel. Production smoke and published Braintrust eval passed with streaming Service API events, jobs-tool usage, forbidden-write checks, secret refusal, and Dify/Langfuse trace IDs; credential values remain in secret storage.
